<issue>
new_placeholder_sp method returns incomplete placeholder shapes

#### Description

When creating new placeholder shapes using `CT_Shape.new_placeholder_sp()`, the method returns shapes that are missing essential placeholder properties and may have unreachable code.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from pptx.oxml.shapes.autoshape import CT_Shape
from pptx.enum.shapes import PP_PLACEHOLDER

# Try to create a new placeholder shape
sp = CT_Shape.new_placeholder_sp(
    id_=1, 
    name="Title 1", 
    ph_type=PP_PLACEHOLDER.TITLE, 
    orient="horz", 
    sz="full", 
    idx=0
)

# The resulting shape will be missing placeholder configuration
print(sp.xml)  # Missing expected placeholder properties
```

The method appears to have structural issues where placeholder properties like `type`, `idx`, `orient`, and `sz` are not being properly set on the placeholder element, and some code may be unreachable due to early return statements.
</issue>
